title: PortfoliOS WASM application library
scope: Curated upstream candidates, existing WASM integrations, and explicitly classified related browser apps. Not an exhaustive global registry.

policy.priorityMeaning: Evaluation order, not a promise to ship.
policy.documentationMeaning: Primary upstream references and local code evidence; deployment requires exact artifact versions, hashes, and licensing review.
